fields.name: name
fields.meaning: The database a code repository's SQL writes to, named after the repository.

fields.name: repository
fields.meaning: The product's repository whose code holds the SQL.

fields.name: database
fields.meaning: The database the table stands in, by its name.

fields.name: name
fields.meaning: The table's name, schema-qualified when the SQL names a schema other than public.

fields.name: schema
fields.meaning: The schema the table stands in, when the SQL names one other than public.

fields.name: table
fields.meaning: The table that holds the column, as its database and its name.

fields.name: name
fields.meaning: The column's name.

fields.name: type
fields.meaning: The column's type, as the SQL writes it.

fields.name: nullable
fields.meaning: Whether the column admits null.

fields.name: default
fields.meaning: The column's default value, as the SQL writes it; null when it has none.

fields.name: primary_key
fields.meaning: Whether the column is part of the table's primary key.

fields.name: unique
fields.meaning: Whether the column alone is unique.

fields.name: check
fields.meaning: The CHECK expressions the column holds, as the SQL writes them.

fields.name: table
fields.meaning: The table the index covers, as its database and its name.

fields.name: name
fields.meaning: The index's name.

fields.name: unique
fields.meaning: Whether the index is unique.

fields.name: columns
fields.meaning: The columns the index covers, in order.

fields.name: where
fields.meaning: The predicate of a partial index, as the SQL writes it; null when it covers every row.

fields.name: column
fields.meaning: The column that holds the key.

fields.name: target_column
fields.meaning: The column it references.

fields.name: constraint
fields.meaning: The name the SQL gives the foreign key, when it names one.
